title: Memanto memory
description: Memanto-backed project memory for the GSD lifecycle. Fails closed: a blocking gate halts the workflow when the configured Memanto agent or endpoints are not healthy.
author: The Artificer of Ciphers LLC

memanto.enabled.description: Enables the Memanto capability for this project; only the boolean true activates it.

memanto.agent_id.description: The Memanto agent id this project reads and writes; it must be set explicitly, and an empty value blocks every gate.

memanto.backend_url.description: Full URL with scheme of the pre-running Memanto backend; an empty value blocks every gate.

memanto.api_url.description: Full URL with scheme of the pre-running Memanto REST API; an empty value blocks every gate.
